source: DubaiNest market notes (hand-written in June 2026, not yet checked against Dubai Land Department open data)

overview.escrow_note: Dubai Land Department escrow rules hold buyer payments until construction milestones

Downtown Dubai.profile: Flagship location; deepest resale market; appreciation play.

Business Bay.profile: Dense commercial district with strong rental demand; yield play.

Palm Jumeirah.profile: Premium waterfront; seasonal luxury rentals; appreciation play.

MBR City.profile: Crystal lagoons, family-oriented, newer stock; yield play.

Dubai Hills Estate.profile: Golf community with a villa and apartment mix.

Dubai Creek Harbour.profile: Emerging district; upside tied to Creek Tower.

Dubai Maritime City.profile: Off-plan waterfront peninsula; yields estimated by comparison with Palm Jumeirah.

Dubailand.profile: Master-planned suburban communities (including DAMAC Islands); no yield benchmark in these notes.
